title: The capybara you helped shape is out now. Free on iPhone
author: Appropriate_Spot_621
selftext:
A couple of months ago I posted a very early capybara prototype here and asked if I should keep going. You said yes and gave me a list: let him swim, let him climb, make the backpack matter, add a pelican. All of it made it into the game.

  
Capybara Boy: Epic Adventures is out now. A young capybara rescues his friends from cages across a sleepy jungle, a busy city, a zoo with nine locks and a Halloween night lit by a flying pumpkin. Every rescue is a small puzzle, you trade odd items with the locals, and the hero never hurries. It's free and plays offline.

  
App Store: [https://apps.apple.com/app/id6828830797](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6828830797)

  
Thanks for the push. What do you think of the trailer?

comments.author: Braunb8888
comments.body: Bad way to think of this world. Be a good teammate, other players may be better than you, but you’ll get help along the way if you’re good to them.
